published_evidence.exploitation_evidence: When a contribution fails, the remaining ETH is not correctly calculated and refunded to the user, resulting in the user losing funds.
published_evidence.fix_strategy_evidence: Move the ethAvailable decrement operation after the contributeFor() call.
published_evidence.root_cause_evidence: Decrement the ethAvailable before each contributeFor() call.

   180 |     /// @notice `contribute()` in batch form.
   181 |     ///         May not revert if any individual contribution fails.
   182 |     /// @param args The arguments to pass to each `contribute()` call.
   183 |     /// @return votingPowers The voting power received for each contribution.
   184 |     function batchContribute(
   185 |         BatchContributeArgs calldata args
   186 |     ) external payable onlyDelegateCall returns (uint96[] memory votingPowers) {
   187 |         uint256 numContributions = args.tokenIds.length;
   188 |         votingPowers = new uint96[](numContributions);
   189 | 
   190 |         uint256 ethAvailable = msg.value;
   191 |         for (uint256 i; i < numContributions; ++i) {
   192 |             ethAvailable -= args.values[i];
   193 | 
   194 |             votingPowers[i] = _contribute(
   195 |                 payable(msg.sender),
   196 |                 args.delegate,
   197 |                 args.values[i],
   198 |                 args.tokenIds[i],
   199 |                 args.gateDatas[i]
   200 |             );
   201 |         }
   202 | 
   203 |         // Refund any unused ETH.
   204 |         if (ethAvailable > 0) payable(msg.sender).transfer(ethAvailable);
   205 |     }

   207 |     /// @notice Contribute to this crowdfund on behalf of another address.
   208 |     /// @param tokenId The ID of the token to credit the contribution to, or
   209 |     ///                zero to mint a new party card for the recipient
   210 |     /// @param recipient The address to record the contribution under
   211 |     /// @param initialDelegate The address to delegate to for the governance
   212 |     ///                        phase if recipient hasn't delegated
   213 |     /// @param gateData Data to pass to the gatekeeper to prove eligibility
   214 |     /// @return votingPower The voting power received for the contribution
   215 |     function contributeFor(
   216 |         uint256 tokenId,
   217 |         address payable recipient,
   218 |         address initialDelegate,
   219 |         bytes memory gateData
   220 |     ) external payable onlyDelegateCall returns (uint96 votingPower) {
